```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME, summary_est) |>
  summarize(
    bachelor_pct = sum(
      estimate[variable %in% c(
        "B15003_022",
        "B15003_023",
        "B15003_024",
        "B15003_025"
      )],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, bachelor_pct), y = bachelor_pct)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Share of Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
